_comment: Copy this to connectors.json (same dir as the running engine, or set SPARKBYTE_STATE_DIR) and flip a connector's "enabled" to true. Each entry launches an external MCP server over stdio; its tools appear to the agent as mcp__<name>__<tool>. Everything is opt-in — with all connectors disabled (or no connectors.json at all) the engine behaves exactly as before. Put secrets in the connector's own env, not here.
